turns.utterance: Starting vision system diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please complete the following visual checks: First, inspect the lens front element at oblique incidence for any scratches or chips. Second, check the lens housing for impact cracks or a loose retaining ring. Third, inspect the lens mount face for contamination or swarf.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the lens front element at oblique incidence for scratches or chips. 2. Check the lens housing for impact cracks or loose retaining ring. 3. Inspect the lens mount face for contamination or swarf.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All three checks complete. The lens element is clear, housing is intact, and the mount face is clean.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect the lens front element at oblique incidence for scratches or chips. 2. Check the lens housing for impact cracks or loose retaining ring. 3. Inspect the lens mount face for contamination or swarf.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Are there any lens scratches, chips, or contamination present?

ground_truth.node_text: Lens scratches, chips or contamination present?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the lens is clean and undamaged.

ground_truth.node_text: Lens scratches, chips or contamination present?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the lighting intensity within the specified range at the part plane?

ground_truth.node_text: Lighting intensity within specified range at part plane?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The illuminance readings are below specification, particularly at the corners where it drops to about 70% of center value.

ground_truth.node_text: Lighting intensity within specified range at part plane?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the lighting voltage or replace the LEDs as required to bring the intensity back to specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust lighting voltage or replace LEDs as required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've increased the lighting voltage and the illuminance is now within range across the entire field.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust lighting voltage or replace LEDs as required

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Now clean the lens surface. Blow dry compressed air across it to remove loose particles, then apply two drops of optical lens cleaner to a lint-free cloth and wipe using a single outward spiral motion from center to edge. Inspect under oblique light and repeat if you see any smearing or residue.

ground_truth.node_text: Blow dry compressed air across the lens surface to remove loose particles. Apply two drops of optical lens cleaner to a lint free cloth and wipe the lens surface using a single outward spiral motion from centre to edge. Inspect the lens under oblique light after cleaning and repeat if smearing or residue is visible.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Lens cleaning complete. Surface is clean with no smearing or residue visible.

ground_truth.node_text: Blow dry compressed air across the lens surface to remove loose particles. Apply two drops of optical lens cleaner to a lint free cloth and wipe the lens surface using a single outward spiral motion from centre to edge. Inspect the lens under oblique light after cleaning and repeat if smearing or residue is visible.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the image sharpness within the sharpness specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Image sharpness within sharpness specification specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the modulation transfer function meets the acceptance criteria across all quadrants.

ground_truth.node_text: Image sharpness within sharpness specification specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the distortion within plus or minus 0.5 pixels at the corner positions?

ground_truth.node_text: Distortion within ±0.5 px at corner positions?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, maximum distortion measured is 0.3 pixels at the corners, well within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Distortion within ±0.5 px at corner positions?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the calibration residual error within 0.1 pixels root mean square?

ground_truth.node_text: Calibration residual error within 0.1 px root mean square?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the reprojection error is reading 0.14 pixels RMS, which exceeds the limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Calibration residual error within 0.1 px root mean square?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Rerun the calibration with new target images, using a minimum of 20 poses.

ground_truth.node_text: Rerun calibration with new target images, 20 poses minimum

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Calibration rerun complete with 22 target poses captured and processed.

ground_truth.node_text: Rerun calibration with new target images, 20 poses minimum

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the calibration residual after recalibration.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify calibration residual after recalibration

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The residual error is now 0.08 pixels RMS, within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify calibration residual after recalibration

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the trigger delay within plus or minus 0.5 milliseconds of specification?

ground_truth.node_text: Trigger delay within ±0.5 ms of specification?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the measured delay is 0.2 milliseconds off target, well within the tolerance band.

ground_truth.node_text: Trigger delay within ±0.5 ms of specification?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the false reject rate below 0.5 percent?

ground_truth.node_text: False reject rate below 0.5%?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, only one part out of 200 was incorrectly flagged, giving us a 0.5 percent rate exactly at the threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: False reject rate below 0.5%?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Were all known rejects correctly detected?

ground_truth.node_text: All known rejects correctly detected?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, two of the ten defective parts were accepted by the system instead of being rejected.

ground_truth.node_text: All known rejects correctly detected?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Detection capability is insufficient. Escalate this issue for algorithm review. Do not resume production until the vision engineer has evaluated and corrected the detection logic.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: detection capability insufficient, algorithm review required

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, I'll contact the vision engineer immediately and hold production.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: detection capability insufficient, algorithm review required
